name: linkedin-agent-skill
title_zh: 21 个钩子公式轮着用，发帖前先过 AI 指纹检测
tagline_zh: LinkedIn 冷启动最怕没人理。这套技能集把发帖、评论、回复、周计划全包了。
tagline_en: Cold-starting LinkedIn? This skill set drafts posts, comments, replies, and weekly plans—plus a humanizer that.
desc_en: Eleven free Claude skills that run a LinkedIn account: posts off 21 hook formulas, comments, replies, profile score, weekly plan, and a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint and scores the draft before it goes out.
why_zh: 不是模板堆砌，而是把钩子拆成 21 种可复用公式，配合人味评分器在发布前拦截机器腔。
why_en: Not another template pack. Hooks are decomposed into 21 reusable formulas, and the humanizer blocks robotic phrasing.
limit_zh: 只服务 LinkedIn 英文内容场景，不覆盖多平台分发。需要你有 Claude 订阅和 API 额度。
limit_en: English LinkedIn only; no cross-posting. Needs Claude subscription and API credits. Humanizer uses statistical cues, may misflag niche jargon.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 21 hook formulas plus an AI-fingerprint scorer before.
